function: Excluded (function): the learned AGGRNN and MVSFNet densify sensing point clouds for ISAC 4D environment reconstruction, a sensing-only function. p. 1: "to enhance the density of sparsely reconstructed point clouds".
notes: Reason function. The learned models are point cloud completion networks (AGGRNN, MVSFNet, p. 8-10) applied after classical sensing (2D-FFT, CFAR, MUSIC, p. 5-6); they design no beams, waveforms, or resources serving sensing and communication, so area 5 does not fit, and no other area applies. The transmit beamforming vector appears only in the signal model (p. 4). Evaluation is on reconstruction only: p. 11 "we use both Chamfer Distance (CD) and F-Score as quantitative evaluation metrics" against point cloud networks (Table II, p. 12). No_learning and above_phy do not apply: deep learning is the core of the method and acts on sensing output, not on network functions. PDF is arXiv 2404.14862v1, Deep Learning Based Multi-Node ISAC 4D Environmental Reconstruction with Uplink-Downlink Cooperation; it does not print the DOI.
